title: Condition Assessment
description: A qualitative conservation inspection (CRMsci E14 Condition Assessment) recording the condition state of a heritage object or place, encoded as a GeoJSON/JSON-FG Feature: CIDOC-CRM/CRMsci attributes nest under `properties` (GeoJSON convention), and a `choType` property carries the CRMsci class as a second alias to `@type`, alongside the fixed `type: "Feature"`. Localisation is optional: `geometry` may be `null` (no spatial localisation), an embedded GeoJSON geometry, or given by reference via topology (`topology`, see ogc.geo.topo.features.topo-feature) to avoid duplicating coordinates already recorded on the affected object.

choType.description: CRMsci class discriminator for this record (maps to sci:E14_Condition_Assessment via a second alias to @type, alongside the fixed GeoJSON `type: "Feature"`).

affectedObject.description: URI of the heritage-object, architectural-space or place being assessed.

conditionState.description: The E3 Condition State found by this assessment: the type of condition, its severity and a textual description of its spatial extent.

conditionType.description: Getty AAT URI for the type of condition (e.g. crack, moisture, corrosion).

extent.description: Textual description of the area, length or volume affected.

assessmentDate.description: Date on which the assessment was carried out (ISO 8601).

assessor.description: URI of the agent (person or organisation) who carried out the assessment.

method.description: Label or URI of the inspection technique used (e.g. "visual inspection", "thermographic survey", "photogrammetric analysis").

confidence.description: Confidence level in the assessment result.

evidence.description: URIs of digital representations or archival documents used as evidence.

recommendation.description: Free-text conservation recommendation arising from this assessment.

reviewStatus.description: Workflow status of this record (e.g. draft, reviewed, approved).

allOf.description: Condition assessment localised by its own embedded geometry, or not spatially localised at all (`geometry: null`).

id.description: Persistent URI identifying this condition assessment record (overrides the inherited `id`, which also allows a bare number).
